'''Horse: The Book''' is a power [[Books|book]] that can be purchased from the [[Bookseller]] for {{Price|25000}}.

The first reading grants the player a power that makes them gain {{Name|Speed|+0.5|class=inline}} when riding their [[horse]].<ref name="movementSpeed" /> Once read, it can be found in [[the Player]]'s Menu on the [[Special Items & Powers]] tab. Each subsequent reading gives the player 20 [[Skills|XP]] in each of the 5 skills.

==Bundles==
Horse: The Book is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Horse: The Book is not used in any [[tailoring]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as a brown dye when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
Horse: The Book is not used in any [[quests]].
